definitions.explanation: The party who buys in a sale, especially in a contract, real estate deal, or legal document. The counterpart of the seller, {売主|うりぬし}.

examples.japanese: {買主|かいぬし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{売主|うりぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{買主|かいぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The contract has the names of the seller and the buyer written on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{所有権|しょゆうけん}→所有権：17082_shoyuuken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{売主|うりぬし}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{買主|かいぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}る→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: Once the property has been handed over, ownership passes from the seller to the buyer.

notes:
A term from contracts, real estate, and law. In everyday speech, ⟦{買|か}い{手|て}→買い手：24770_kaite⟧ (buyer) or ⟦お{客|きゃく}さん→お客さん：10253_okyakusan⟧ is more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売主|うりぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{買主|かいぬし}: seller and buyer
- {買主|かいぬし}⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧: paid by the buyer
- {買主|かいぬし}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the buyer's side

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as ⟦{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}→飼い主：15281_kainushi⟧ (the owner of a pet). The kanji tell them apart: ⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ "buy" vs ⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ "keep (an animal)".
